implementation_plan: Define request and response models with required keys, types, bounds, and extra-field policy.
Validate the HTTP request before sending any model request.
Parse the model response as JSON and run application-level validation; distinguish invalid JSON from valid JSON with invalid fields.
Return a safe 4xx/5xx error shape without including secrets or raw sensitive provider output.
Keep the model call behind a replaceable service function and test it using a mock.
